Local receipt OCR assets: Tesseract.js 6.0.1 (Apache-2.0), tesseract.js-core 6.0.0 (Apache-2.0), tessdata_fast English and Thai models at 87416418657359cb625c412a48b6e1d6d41c29bd (Apache-2.0).
Files downloaded from official npm distributions and tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast. Image pixels stay in the browser; all runtime assets served from this website. Models cached by Tesseract.js in IndexedDB. Loaded only on slip upload.
The .wasm.js builds embed the WASM binary; separate .wasm files are not required.
